specificity_tier: Tier 1: Direct Individual Practice Location (Attached to Individual Enrollment ID)
Tier 2: Unique Group-Associated Location (1 ZIP5 in 1 State via Billing Group)
Tier 3: Small Intrastate Multi-Site Group (2-5 Unique ZIP5s in 1 State)
Tier 4: Large Intrastate Multi-Site Group (>5 Unique ZIP5s in 1 State)
Tier 5: Multi-State / Interstate Billing Group Locations (>=2 States)
Tier 6: No Practice Location Linked in PECOS (Neither Direct Nor Group)
